# Ditto SN118

> Public transparency dashboard for Bittensor Subnet 118 (Ditto). Live miner leaderboard, submission pipeline, validator fleet, and DittoBench scoring. All numbers come from the platform's public read API; nothing here is a sample.

The dashboard is the human front door. The same data is available as JSON with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=30`, so a crawler that wants the current standings should fetch the API rather than scrape the SPA.

## Live JSON (max-age=30s)

- Leaderboard: https://platform-api.heyditto.ai/api/v1/public/leaderboard
- Health: https://platform-api.heyditto.ai/api/v1/public/health
- Submission activity: https://platform-api.heyditto.ai/api/v1/public/activity
- Validator / screener fleet: https://platform-api.heyditto.ai/api/v1/public/operations
- Revealed on-chain weights: https://platform-api.heyditto.ai/api/v1/public/weights
- Benchmark timeline: https://platform-api.heyditto.ai/api/v1/public/bench/timeline
- Benchmark config: https://platform-api.heyditto.ai/api/v1/public/bench/config
- Benchmark glossary: https://platform-api.heyditto.ai/api/v1/public/bench/glossary

## What this site is

SN118 scores miner-submitted AI memory agents on DittoBench. Validators independently score each submission; the platform publishes the aggregate board, the KOTH emissions projection, and the public evidence record. Rank is by official composite on the active benchmark, not raw median alone.

This host is not the consumer Ditto assistant. It does not accept sign-ups and it does not serve private product data.

## Machine-readable companion

- https://platform-api.heyditto.ai/llms-full.txt — public API map and scoring vocabulary
- https://platform-api.heyditto.ai/sitemap.xml — crawlable page list, refreshed with the board
